decisions.reason: This trend-driven devore fabric is near the end of a typical collection cycle and competes with many other options, but there is no sign it failed and keeping a stocked variant costs little, so it stays for now.

This transparent burnout fabric is a fashion item likely to be rotated out eventually, but carrying it in the existing warehouse and ordering system costs little and there is no evidence its value has collapsed.
This burnout fabric overlaps with the other burnout lines, which raises the chance of pruning, but low carrying costs and reorder continuity for retail customers favour keeping it.
Velour-like upholstery fabric is a durable category with steady demand, and keeping it on the market costs little.
Flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric is a functional staple needed for contract and retail buyers, so its value is likely being realized and it should be kept.
Satin polyester lining is a basic complementary product supporting the made-to-measure sewing business, so it has low carrying cost and steady value.
